from.description: The consumer: the service whose environment gets the provider's variables.

to.description: The provider: the service whose first port the link opens.

tenant.description: Optional. The tenant to act in: the verb then sees and changes only that tenant's project. Left out, it acts in the node's own project. A node without kernel.tenants has no tenants.

env.description: The environment variable names, never their values.

reach.description: Where the dash is published: "tailnet", the only reach there is.

node.description: The tailnet node the dash is served from: arca-<name>.

url.description: Its address on the tailnet: https://<node>.<tailnet>.ts.net:8443/ (no dash token: the dash asks for its own).

key.description: The secret's name, one of the template's secrets.

name.description: The service name (1-40 of a-z, 0-9 and inner "-", starting with a letter).

value.description: The secret. A container's is one line of 8 to 4096 characters without control characters: it is an environment value, so a line break at its end is refused. A virtual machine's is a file in its guest and is stored as given, with the line break at its end when it has one (a key file read whole): 8 to 4096 characters not counting that one line break, with line breaks and no other control character, each carriage return and line feed pair stored as one line feed.

tenant.description: Optional. The tenant to act in: the verb then sees and changes only that tenant's project. Left out, it acts in the node's own project. A node without kernel.tenants has no tenants.
